example.title: Dog Bar Breakwater, Eastern Point, Gloucester

brief: A long granite-block breakwater running out from the lighthouse point across the harbour mouth: a flat walkable crest of big dressed granite blocks, a small light at the end. Two photos. Older than 1970 (1894-1905): no newer granite breakwater of this kind. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
